name: Biomedic Appliances
old_description: We are pleased to share that Bio-Medic Appliances, Inc. has joined the Hanger Clinic family. Although the Bio-Medic Appliances name will change to Hanger Clinic, your clinical team will remain the same, with the added benefit of accessing more locations if you so choose. As part of the Hanger Clinic family, you can expect the same clinical excellence on which Bio-Medic Appliances built their reputation, combined with the peace of mind that comes with a company steeped in nearly 160 years of efficient and effective clinical care and outstanding customer service. ​​
